dataset_title: Site-level standing-biomass observations from ten Dutch roadside grasslands, 2023
source_title: Grassland management in a changing climate: Insights from a Dutch road verge study — data and scripts

dataset_doi_candidates.evidence: Zenodo record metadata identifies this as the version DOI; the article's data-availability statement cites this identifier.
Zenodo record metadata identifies this as the concept DOI; the Wageningen University & Research portal's linked dataset entry cites this identifier.

byte_fidelity_note: This legacy root copy has LF line endings; the exact Zenodo file, including original CRLF line endings and matching MD5, is preserved at verbatim_source_asset. Parsed rows and values were checked equal.
measurement_basis: Published 2023 roadside-plot standing biomass values in source units (g dry matter/m²); Productivity is a site-level standing-biomass productivity field. One blank Biomass measurement remains missing, not zero.
license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), as stated on Zenodo version record 15349657
applicability: Direct Dutch road-verge field observations for standing biomass and mowing-regime context. They are not harvested mass, annual regrowth, collection efficiency, contracted availability, or GreenHub process feed.
limitations: The article's data-availability statement and WUR portal cite different DOI roles; Zenodo record metadata resolves 15349657 as the version DOI and 15349656 as the concept DOI.
The Zenodo record license applies to the deposited dataset, not necessarily to the related article or other repository copies.
Biomass values are standing biomass measurements, not measured mass captured by collection equipment or deliverable supply.
The authors' R analysis script is now preserved unchanged with the exact Zenodo CSV in the adjacent source package; the unit conversion it documents is dimensional only.
One missing Biomass value remains blank; the plot design and site sample are not a randomized estimate of regional Dutch supply.
